observation_summary: The ODE integrator fails to stop at the specified end time, effectively overshooting the integration range because it does not correctly handle the final step when the remaining time is extremely small.
reasoning_summary: The fix involves adding explicit state updates (storing time, copying state, and setting step size to zero) when the remaining step size is negligible. This is a procedural correction to the integration loop logic to ensure the algorithm correctly terminates at the target time, rather than a simple guard or initialization error.
evidence_used: The fix adds 'interpolator.storeTime(stepStart);', 'System.arraycopy(y, 0, yTmp, 0, y0.length);', and 'stepSize = 0;' inside the loop logic.
The bug report states the integrator goes past the specified end of the integration range.
The fix modifies the loop termination logic in both EmbeddedRungeKuttaIntegrator and RungeKuttaIntegrator.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the fix involves assigning values to stepSize and state, these assignments are part of a procedural correction to the integration loop's termination strategy, not just a simple initialization of a variable.
The fix is not just adding a guard condition; it is adding the necessary state-handling operations to correctly terminate the algorithm when the condition is met.
